purpose: First controlled mutation experiment: insert the persisted exact onset as an integration interval boundary and opt-in hand off only the genuine model=2 Newtonian integrated carrier state before a short post-handoff evolution canary.

canary_domain.completion_point_selection: the first persisted 3x3 completion-grid point used by C10.65r2

implementation_contract: add a model=2 opt-in handoff flag with default exactly OFF
derive tau_on deterministically from the pinned background and persisted a_on; no hard-coded tau from another cosmology
if tau_on lies strictly inside an existing perturb_solve approximation interval, split that interval into two while duplicating the unchanged approximation-state vector on both sides
do not modify perturb_find_approximation_switches criteria, TCA thresholds, collision coefficients, or approximation flags
at the post-split interval entry, call the ordinary perturb_vector_init redistribution first, then perform exactly one handoff before generic_evolver
handoff writes only pv->y[index_pt_delta_cdm] and pv->y[index_pt_theta_cdm] in model=2 Newtonian gauge
no state mutation is allowed inside perturb_derivs or perturb_sources callbacks
metric, lapse/curvature, B/shift, projector quantities and completed-U1 constraint quantities remain algebraic diagnostics and are never inserted as integrated state
emit explicit before-state, after-state, tau_on, a(tau_on), approximation flags and first-post-handoff RHS diagnostics for certification
short-step canary must remain local to the four low-k anchors and must not be promoted to spectra
constraint_drift_definition: For each algebraic completed-U1 diagnostic residual available at the handoff, compare absolute residual at the frozen short-step endpoint with max(abs(residual_at_handoff),1e-300); the largest ratio is the reported growth factor. This is a local numerical canary, not a long-time stability theorem.
next_if_pass: C10.65r3c: expand the same unchanged handoff architecture to the full 3x3x4 completion grid and multiple frozen short-step fractions before any production feedback/spectra run.
next_if_fail: Classify the failure as interval-split/rollback, handoff mapping, first-RHS parity, or short-step drift. Fix only the identified implementation/physics defect; do not loosen this frozen target without a separately documented scientific reason.
non_claims: not resolution of C9 naturalness or broader C7 weak-field completion
